proposals.before: Well versed in current affairs, he was recommended by Grand Secretary Wenshang for talent in foreign service.
proposals.after: Well versed in current affairs, he was recommended by Grand Secretary Wenxiang for talent in foreign service.
proposals.reason: 文祥 is Wenxiang; Wenshang is a misspelling of the personal name in the idiomatic English.

proposals.before: He was well versed in current affairs; Grand Secretary Wenshang recommended him for diplomatic talent.
proposals.after: He was well versed in current affairs; Grand Secretary Wenxiang recommended him for diplomatic talent.
proposals.reason: 文祥 is Wenxiang; Wenshang is a misspelling of the personal name in the literal English.

proposals.before: In the ninth year of Xianfeng he passed the metropolitan examination in Shuntian; at the beginning of the Tongzhi reign he served as a Grand Council clerk and concurrently attended the Zongli Yamen.
proposals.after: In the ninth year of Xianfeng he passed the provincial examination in Shuntian; at the beginning of the Tongzhi reign he served as a Grand Council clerk and concurrently attended the Zongli Yamen.
proposals.reason: 鄉試 is the provincial examination; metropolitan (會試) is incorrect in the literal rendering.

proposals.before: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month Boxers suddenly arrested him at home and marched him to Prince Zhuang's residence.
proposals.after: On the sixteenth day of the seventh month Boxers suddenly arrested him at home and marched him to Prince Zhuang's residence.
proposals.reason: 既望 is the day after the full moon (望), i.e. the sixteenth, not the fifteenth.

decisions.reason: s0033 names 大學士文祥; standard Mandarin for 文祥 is Wenxiang, so idiomatic 'Wenshang' is a misspelling. The proposed replacement corrects only that name.
The same focus phrase 大學士文祥 is misspelled 'Wenshang' in the literal field; 'Wenxiang' correctly romanizes 文祥 without changing the rest of the sentence.

s0003 has 舉順天鄉試. 鄉試 is the provincial examination; 會試 would be the metropolitan examination. The literal 'metropolitan examination' is wrong, and the proposed 'provincial examination' matches the Chinese (and the already-correct idiomatic rendering).
s0024 dates the arrest 七月既望. 望 is the fifteenth (full moon); 既望 is the day after, the sixteenth. Idiomatic 'fifteenth' misreads 既望 as 望; the proposed sixteenth is accurate.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows the English personal name 'Wenshang' was created solely by the bad romanization of 文祥; the name claim remains, but en must be Wenxiang to match the Chinese and pinyin already recorded.
